reasoning: This repository implements the llm-d Inference Payload Processor as a standalone runtime service. The Go entry point starts a controller-runtime manager and an Envoy external-processing gRPC server; the server inspects and mutates inference request and response payloads through configurable plugins. Kubernetes Deployment and Service manifests expose the processor on gRPC, health, and metrics ports, and a Helm application chart packages its deployment configuration.
